family: All 24 models: periods 1 through 12, equations C=P+K and C=K-P modulo 26; unrestricted periodic key entries
null: Uniformly shuffle all 97 ciphertext positions, preserving the entire observed letter histogram; refit all 24 models to each shuffle
statistic: Number of models passing the full 13-letter training crib
tail: Number of passing models at least the observed value
random_generator: Python standard-library random.Random(seed), random.shuffle of the original ciphertext list separately in every replicate
reporting: Null count distribution, per-model pass counts, empirical exceedance fraction, plus-one Monte Carlo p=(b+1)/(N+1), descriptive 95% Wilson binomial interval for the null exceedance probability
scope: Only this frozen 24-periodic-model family, not the larger history of investigated hypotheses, alphabets, geometries or rotor models. This is not a posterior probability that the cipher is correct.
